Hi Rishi / Sergio / Monica,

Thanks again for the discussion earlier — CloudAccelerate is running a private accelerator cohort (Nov–Jan) where each startup gets a 6–8 week technical pilot. We’d like Redwood to provide partner-sponsored credits to cover model inference costs for 8 teams (roughly 2M tokens / team over the pilot).

High-level ask: $5,000 in promotional credits, applied as a marketplace grant or partner promo code so teams can spin up pilots quickly. We’ll coordinate marketing/intro calls and want to include a short case study if the pilot converts.

Attached: high-level MAP for the cohort (MAP_v2.pdf).

Can you confirm feasibility and any compliance/contract needs? We’re on a tight timeline — first demo cohort starts Dec 1.
